verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse returns structured JSON with layout, where each element is typed and positioned. It handles multi-column text, and variable chunking splits at semantic boundaries such as section headers, which implies some heading and section awareness. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a heading/section hierarchy or a reading-order guarantee in the output. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a hierarchical heading/section tree in parse output, an explicit reading-order guarantee, and independent hands-on corroboration of structure preservation.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, parsed output preserves document hierarchy — headings, sections, reading order — so downstream LLMs see structure, not soup

citations.quote: It converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting
Each element includes its type, page position, and confidence score. Parse handles multi-column text, nested tables, forms with handwriting, rotated pages
Variable chunking splits at semantic boundaries like section headers, tables, and figures, keeping related content together
You will parse a document and get back structured JSON ready for LLMs
